hook_line: WALLER BACKS DECEMBER HIKE, OPENS DOOR TO HALF-POINT MOVE

hook_stat.sub: October core CPI rise, exactly the bar Waller set for considering a 50-basis-point hike

stats.label: Basis points: the minimum December hike Waller said he would support
Chance futures priced for a December hike before the inflation data

diaspora_bullets: A December hike would keep upward pressure on mortgage rates, car loans and credit-card APRs
After the data, market odds of a half-point move rose to about 15%
news_summary: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said he would support at least a 25-basis-point rate hike at the December 8-9 FOMC meeting, and that a core CPI rise of 0.3% or more should prompt consideration of a 50-basis-point hike.
payoff: October core CPI then rose exactly 0.3%, meeting Waller's bar for a bigger move.
